entities.summary: Jonathan Isaiah Jones is an American professional football cornerback for the Philadelphia Eagles of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Auburn Tigers and signed with the New England Patriots as an undrafted free agent in 2016. Jones has also played for the Washington Commanders.
